title: ConsumerFeedback
description: Meta-schema for the consumer feedback runtime message (Welle 2; loadedCommit Block B, 24.09.). A wire message, not a repo object: no route in validate-all.mjs, no folder. grain: loaded reports the model state in effect in the process, as loadedVersion (a released UNSaC version) OR loadedCommit (the full commit of the osf-schemas tree it loaded; the receiver resolves it through its release tags unsac/<version>, and a commit without a release tag is drifting, never unknown and never in agreement). grain: seen reports a window of observed UNS subjects.

loadedCommit.description: Full lowercase commit of the osf-schemas tree in effect in the process; never abbreviated (a short SHA can be ambiguous).
